+title: Use the EditorKit theme for the code, diff, terminal and editor views
+---
+## What
+Decision of the owner (2026-10-11): the views of the kit use EditorKit themes. EditorKit must have an Apple system default theme (separate work in the EditorKit repository).
+
+Today `AgentTheme.editorTheme` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Theme/AgentTheme+EditorKit.swift:28-71`) is a bridge that sends only the accent and the code font. The editor colors come from the kit copy `AgentTheme.EditorSystemColors`. All captures get one color, so the code has no syntax colors. The diff bands use the fixed EditorKit diff colors, but the `+N/−N` counts use `statusColors` (`Diff/DiffView.swift:240`, `:242`). EditorKit falls back to `DefaultTheme.dark` (fixed hex) when no theme is set.
+
+## Work
+- [ ] When EditorKit has its Apple system default theme, move the EditorKit pin to that revision.
+- [ ] `AgentTheme` holds an EditorKit `Theme` (default: the EditorKit system theme). A host can set any EditorKit theme (Zed, VS Code, tmTheme, presets).
+- [ ] Each EditorKit host gets that theme: `Code/CodeBlockView.swift:83`, `Input/EditorKitPromptEditor.swift:95`, `Diff/DiffRendererSlot+EditorKit.swift:74`, `Terminal/TerminalView.swift:180`, `Content/CommandOutputView.swift:180`, `Elicitation/ElicitationFieldViews.swift:224`. Keep the code font override only if the host sets it.
+- [ ] The frames and bars of these views read the editor background and bar colors from the theme (`Code/CodeBlockView.swift:77`, `:116`, `Terminal/TerminalView.swift:174`, `:224`, `Content/CommandOutputView.swift:174`, `:217`). Remove `AgentTheme.EditorSystemColors` and the bridge-only colors. Do not keep a kit copy of the EditorKit colors.
+- [ ] The diff counts and the diff bands use the same diff colors of the theme.
+- [ ] `Attachments/AttachmentPreview.swift:206` uses `EditorKitCodeBlockStyle`, so that Markdown previews use the same theme.
+- [ ] Tests: each EditorKit host gets the theme of `AgentTheme`; a custom theme changes the frame and the diff colors. Update `AgentThemeTests` (bridge mapping) and the golden tokens.
+- [ ] README: a theme section. Demo: show how to set a theme.
\ No newline at end of file
